characters.continuity: Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon
characters.summary: Alolan Meowth is a Dark-type Pokémon that relies on cunning, scratching attacks, and bite techniques rather than raw physical strength.
limitations: Physical frailness compared to fully evolved Pokémon
characters.formDifferences: Changes type from normal to dark, alters appearance, and replaces abilities and move pool traits compared to Kanto Meowth.

sources.supports: Alolan Meowth typing, abilities, and regional differences.

unknowns: Exact wild temperament variations across different regions

characters.summary: Galarian Meowth is a Steel-type Pokémon characterized by a dense beard of hair and fierce claw-based attacks.
limitations: Slow speed relative to standard Meowth forms
characters.formDifferences: Changes type to pure Steel, features a hardened beard, and evolves into Perrserker instead of Persian.

sources.supports: Galarian Meowth typing, evolution into Perrserker, and steel-based moves.

unknowns: Origin of the iron-like hardening in its hair

characters.summary: Gigantamax Meowth grows to an immense elongated size and uses special G-Max moves to scatter gold coins and paralyze opponents.

mechanisms: Massive HP pool due to Dynamax energy

weaknesses: Time limit of the Dynamax phenomenon
limitations: Effect wears off automatically after three turns
characters.formDifferences: Massively elongates body structure, gains Gigantamax exclusivity, and replaces standard moves with G-Max variants.

sources.supports: Gigantamax form attributes, G-Max Gold Rush, and size transformation.

conditional.ability: Gigantamax form and G-Max Gold Rush
conditional.dependsOn: Dynamax energy in specific battle locations

campaignTags.claim: Grows to an elongated skyscraper height through the Gigantamax phenomenon.
Transforms into a massive giant temporarily during battle via Dynamax band energy.

unknowns: The precise mechanics of how Dynamax energy alters its coin physiology

characters.summary: Metapod is a cocoon Pokémon that relies on hardening its outer shell to endure incoming attacks while waiting to evolve.

mechanisms: Harden technique to raise physical defense

limitations: Almost entirely immobile except for slight twitching

sources.supports: Metapod move pool, defense stats, and cocoon nature.

unknowns: Internal cellular transformation processes during shell phase

characters.summary: Mew is a legendary psychic Pokémon capable of learning any move, turning invisible, and traveling freely through the air.
limitations: Relies on versatility rather than overwhelming specialized power

sources.supports: Mew's ability to learn all technical machines, invisibility, and psychic powers.

campaignTags.claim: Floats and flies freely through the air without wings.
Can make itself completely invisible at will.

unknowns: Full genetic relationship to other Pokémon species

characters.summary: Mewtwo is a genetically engineered psychic powerhouse capable of devastating energy blasts, telekinesis, and flight.
limitations: Vulnerable to surprise attacks when concentrating power

sources.supports: Mewtwo's psychic move pool, origins, and combat capabilities.

campaignTags.claim: Levitates and flies at high speeds using psychic power.
Master of advanced psychic combat techniques.
Lifts and hurls massive objects and opponents with the mind.

unknowns: Limits of its genetic enhancement ceiling

characters.summary: Mega Mewtwo X is a towering psychic and fighting form that trades some special attack for immense physical muscle and striking power.
limitations: Requires active Mega Evolution trigger per battle
characters.formDifferences: Adds Fighting type, significantly increases physical attack power and bulk, and alters body posture.

sources.supports: Mega Mewtwo X typing, stat redistribution, and fighting attributes.

conditional.dependsOn: Mewtwonite X stone and Mega Bracelet resonance

campaignTags.claim: Retains levitation and flight capabilities in Mega Form.
Maintains powerful psychic energy alongside physical enhancements.

unknowns: Strain of prolonged Mega Evolution on base biology

characters.summary: Mega Mewtwo Y is a compact, highly accelerated psychic form focused on overwhelming special attack and psychic speed.
limitations: Requires Mewtwonite Y and trainer resonance
characters.formDifferences: Reduces physical bulk, increases special attack and speed, and shifts appearance with a horn-like appendage.

sources.supports: Mega Mewtwo Y special attack stats, speed, and psychic abilities.

conditional.dependsOn: Mewtwonite Y stone and Mega Bracelet resonance

campaignTags.claim: Hovers and flies effortlessly using amplified psychic power.
Amplified psychic mastery surpassing standard Mewtwo.

unknowns: Exact limits of its amplified mental processing speed

characters.summary: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that commands intense fire abilities, bathing the battlefield in flames and soaring on fiery wings.
limitations: Extremely vulnerable to stealth rocks and sharp projectile hazards

sources.supports: Moltres legendary status, fire typing, and move list.

campaignTags.claim: Flies through the air on wings composed of blazing fire.
Generates and controls intense flames and heat waves.
Manipulates fire attacks like Flamethrower and Fire Blast.

unknowns: Exact lifespan and nesting habits in the wild

limitations: Low physical durability when barriers are bypassed
